independence.method: Target-owner threat-model and operational-gate review against MLOps model lineage, retraining, promotion and rollback surfaces.

review.candidate_claim: One Sherman-Morrison deletion from bounded float64 ridge regression matches exact retraining and detects input or parameter tampering.
review.target_use_case: Auditable removal of governed training influence from supported deployed model artifacts under an explicit privacy, security and rollback policy.
review.stopping_rule: Reject current-target promotion when the candidate model class or evidence model does not match a supported deployed artifact; do not reinterpret numerical equality as a privacy guarantee.

gates.criterion: Exact candidate bundle and source revision are identified.
The candidate applies to a supported deployed target model family.
gates.evidence: The reviewed target revision deploys broader model workflows; no supported ridge artifact adopts this certificate.

gates.criterion: Authorized requests bind every removed datum through training, artifact and deployment lineage.
gates.evidence: The candidate hashes a bounded input matrix but does not integrate target authorization or production lineage.

gates.criterion: Claims and adversaries are independently reviewed without treating parameter equality as privacy proof.
gates.evidence: The candidate explicitly provides no privacy guarantee and has no target threat-model review beyond this rejection.

gates.criterion: Repeated removals, rollback, monitoring and artifact replacement are verified.
gates.evidence: Only one local deletion is exercised; no target lifecycle integration exists.

review.rationale: The bounded numerical certificate is valid research evidence but is not applicable to the target's supported model lifecycle and cannot authorize a privacy or production-unlearning claim.
limitations: This rejects promotion of this exact candidate; a separately scoped target-native unlearning design may reuse the numerical invariant as one low-level check.
